name: konami_code
description: Executes the secret Konami Code sequence in Block Garden to unlock dev mode, ore depth scanner, fast growth, and hidden options.

autoExecute.description: Whether to automatically trigger the key sequence in the active game viewport (default: true).

execution.code: const requestId = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); const cmd = new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-commands'); const res = new BroadcastChannel('block-garden-results'); const result = await new Promise((resolve) => { const t = setTimeout(() => { res.close(); resolve('Timed out — game may not be loaded yet.'); }, 15000); res.onmessage = (e) => { if (e.data && e.data.requestId === requestId) { clearTimeout(t); res.close(); resolve(e.data.result); } }; cmd.postMessage({ type: 'blockgarden:konamicode', requestId }); cmd.close(); }); return result;
